body:
Observed on CAM-DESKTOP, standalone guest Android release, Pixel 7 profile emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64), Android 16/API 36, font 1.0. App source ae3efb5a3542e585cee459640831e22d786060f5; docs HEAD effe72e1. Installed APK SHA256 c928662fde864afcd799617b7d85328aa27de8a357b0e44901abcc18546c6ebf.

Reproduction using synthetic data:
1. Resume QA Cycle B's existing workout, with three of five sets saved.
2. Restore the next QA Hold draft containing duration 26 seconds and RPE 7, with optional details collapsed.
3. Inspect the populated actual fields. Their placeholders have disappeared, leaving visually unnamed 26 and 7 boxes.

Expected: persistent visible labels identify actual reps, duration and distance units, and RPE/RIR ranges even after entry or draft restoration.
Actual: reps/duration/distance/RPE/RIR rely on placeholders. Explicit accessibility names are present and correct; this is a visual presentation defect. Actual load already retains its stored kg/lb/unknown label and must remain unchanged.

Evidence: docs/qa/2026-10-14-coach-review/coach-review-a11y-after-direct-resume-ae3efb5a.png and matching JSON/probe receipt will be included in draft PR #351. Native fields identify duration in seconds and RPE 1–10 in their accessibility descriptors. No Complete or Save partial action was taken.

Acceptance:
- Responsive persistent labels in focused/all-sets modes; include empty/populated/restored fields and RIR zero.
- Preserve existing field visibility, accessible names, units/provenance, editable conditions and callbacks.
- Normal and 200% native text: captions wrap and focused actual/voice controls remain reachable above keyboard.
- External export verifies actual records and restored draft values are unchanged by presentation-only QA.
- Appropriate regressions and full npm run verify pass. Physical Samsung/iOS/human usability remain separate gates.
title: Keep actual workout field labels visible after entry and draft restoration
